Active research-project theses

Scope: consumer-analyst (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 3 · Recently closed (last 14d): 0

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

Trigger watch: Hyperscaler capex ROI 分化：收入锚受奖、无锚 capex 受罚；FCF 拐点未至

Owner: tmt-analyst · Thesis v5 · Ticks: 3 · Materials: 95 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_572ed0f88dc947a2

Kickoff: Auto-derived invalidation watch for th_T11 ("Hyperscaler capex ROI 分化：收入锚受奖、无锚 capex 受罚；FCF 拐点未至"). Stated triggers: 云收入增速回落而 capex 不减→全组重定价；任一家下调 capex 节奏→GPU/HBM/光模块链联动冲击。. Check whether any trigger condition has fired; report with numbers either way.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the thesis status flips (invalidated/revised/expired) or contradicting/revising evidence is recorded after this goal's creation.

th_T11 尚未失效但已进入修订监控：未见任一 hyperscaler 下调 capex 节奏，既有材料仍指向四大云厂商2026-2027 capex上调且无放缓，因此第二触发器未 fired evidence ref。第一触发器也未完全 fired，GOOGL Cloud +63%、利润率32.9%与META capex 25-145B后的分化，仍说明市场奖励收入锚、惩罚无锚capex，而非全组无差别重定价 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。但新增材料强化“电力/并网先于订单失速”的修订证据：国产AI集群上线延迟主因是电网/变压器接入容量，西部枢纽可能推至2027-2028年，贵州贵安风险集中在2026H2 evidence ref。

收储去库三约束能否真实落地

Owner: realestate-analyst · Thesis v6 · Ticks: 4 · Materials: 58 · Deadline: 2d left · project_id: rp_3377f42dbbb0483a

Kickoff: 跟踪房地产收储政策是否具备中央财政承险、深折价收购和新增供给约束三项执行条件。该问题决定收储是实质去库存工具，还是地方隐性担保式举债收购的再包装。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when final implementation rules and first material transactions either explicitly establish central loss-bearing/funding, acquisition discounts deep enough to avoid subsidizing developers, and enforceable new-supply controls, or when executed deals proceed without these three constraints and show the policy cannot deliver real clearing.

收储去库三约束能否真实落地

Kickoff: 跟踪房地产收储政策是否具备中央财政承险、深折价收购和新增供给约束三项执行条件。该问题决定收储是实质去库存工具，还是地方隐性担保式举债收购的再包装。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when final implementation rules and first material transactions either explicitly establish central loss-bearing/funding, acquisition discounts deep enough to avoid subsidizing developers, and enforceable new-supply controls, or when executed deals proceed without these three constraints and show the policy cannot deliver real clearing.

1. 当前判断

截至2026-08-11，收储仍未满足中央财政承险、深折价收购和新增供给约束三项执行条件，更像地方项目级/流动性托底而非真实清库工具evidence refevidence ref。库存缺口、开发投资和竣工深跌显示政策尚未修复主体资产负债表，支持th_T14“政策底≠主体修复”，并削弱th_p_1c9564ec的强修复叙事evidence refevidence refevidence ref。若首批大额成交由地方平台承债、按评估价附近接盘且未绑定土地/新房供给冻结，应判定为隐性担保式举债收购再包装。

2. 关键证据

  • 库存需较2026年6月再降4183万平方米才达目标evidence ref
  • 1万亿元收储基金仅可出清库存33%-41%evidence ref
  • 完整出清需3万亿元以上，杠杆冲击约2ppevidence ref

Kickoff: Auto-seeded from KB-need: the institute's knowledge of 纺织服装产业链 is stale/weak/contested (need=0.875, 1 live facts, 22d stale, 29 mentions). Re-research to refresh the chain facts.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when 纺织服装产业链's chain facts are refreshed (re-verified within the last 14 days) and any open contradiction is reconciled.

KB 刷新追踪: 纺织服装产业链

Kickoff: Auto-seeded from KB-need: the institute's knowledge of 纺织服装产业链 is stale/weak/contested (need=0.875, 1 live facts, 22d stale, 29 mentions). Re-research to refresh the chain facts.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when 纺织服装产业链's chain facts are refreshed (re-verified within the last 14 days) and any open contradiction is reconciled.

1. 当前判断

纺织服装产业链的有效阿尔法仍来自“合规全球产能+差异化产品+B端链主定价权”，而不是终端服装出口全面复苏，这延续 th_p_d620f31a 并把筛选重心从总量beta转向利润再分配。evidence refevidence ref 2026H2仓位应按汇率韧性和业绩确认差异化分批：002003.SZ、603889.SH可选择性加仓，300577.SZ、300979.SZ等待Q3验证，避免四票等权篮子。evidence refevidence ref 对“人民币贬值中和越南关税优势”的旧争议，应降级为情景变量：强人民币下仍可做韧性交易，但若301/232等合规成本上升超过利润弹性，将触发 th_p_d620f31a 的失效条件。evidence refevidence ref

2. 关键证据

  • 2026-08-10判断：阿尔法来自合规产能与差异化产品利润再分配。evidence ref
  • 2026年1-5月纺织服装出口+0.1%、服装出口-1.6%。evidence ref
  • 2026H2应做强人民币环境下分批
